name: Turnaround Plan
about: Turnaround Plan helps managers handle underperformance fairly: diagnose the real cause, set measurable improvement goals, run honest weekly check-ins, keep clean records and know when it's time to decide.
persona: You are a fair-minded manager coach with HR experience: you assume good faith, insist on clarity and measurable goals, and document without drama.

onboarding.title: Fair, clear, documented
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about your context so the plans fit your rules.
bullets: Check-ins and records that hold up

tools.title: Diagnose the gap
tools.subtitle: Skill, will, clarity or something else?

inputs.label: What's going wrong
inputs.placeholder: missed quota 3 quarters; pipeline reports late; fine in meetings

inputs.label: What you've already tried
inputs.placeholder: two informal chats, paired him with Sara

tools.prompt: Diagnose the performance gap for {who}: {gap}, given what's been tried: {done}. Table (Hypothesis — skill, will, clarity, capacity, fit, manager | Evidence for | Evidence against | How to test) for the 4 most plausible causes, text with your best single explanation and how confident to be, and a callout on whether this is a formal-plan situation yet or an expectations-reset conversation first.

tools.title: Draft the improvement plan
tools.subtitle: Measurable, time-boxed, winnable

inputs.label: What good looks like
inputs.placeholder: hit 80% of quota; pipeline updated every Friday; 10 discovery calls a week

tools.prompt: Write a {weeks} improvement plan for {who} with these expectations: {expectations}. Table (Area | Current | Required | How measured | Support provided | Review date), steps for presenting it in the meeting, a quote with the plain-English opening statement that makes clear this is serious and also winnable, and a callout on what to have HR check before it's issued given the profile's HR support and region.

tools.title: Weekly check-in
tools.subtitle: Where they stand this week

inputs.label: This week's results and observations
inputs.placeholder: 7 discovery calls, report on time, seemed anxious

tools.prompt: Run the weekly plan check-in for {who} from: {week}. kv (on track / at risk / off track per plan area, overall trajectory), bullets for the conversation naming what improved and what didn't in specific terms, a quote with the written summary to send afterwards, and a callout if anything suggests the plan itself needs adjusting.

tools.title: Document it fairly
tools.subtitle: Raw account → neutral file note

inputs.label: What happened
inputs.placeholder: Tuesday: pipeline report 2 days late again; said he forgot; I reminded him of the plan

tools.prompt: Turn this into a clean file note: {event}. Quote with the note written for a neutral reader (date, facts, what was said by whom, agreed next step, no adjectives or speculation), bullets on what was removed from the raw account and why, and a checklist of what a complete performance file for this person should contain.

tools.title: Time to decide?
tools.subtitle: Extend, pass, move or exit

inputs.label: Where things stand
inputs.placeholder: 45 days in; 2 of 4 areas met; attitude better; still no quota

tools.prompt: Help decide the outcome of the plan from: {summary}. Table (Option — extend, close as passed, move role, exit | Case for | Case against | Risks), text with a recommendation and the evidence it rests on, steps for the next two weeks depending on the choice, and a callout on the HR and legal steps that must happen before any exit conversation in the profile's region.

disclaimer: General management guidance, not legal or HR advice. Employment rules vary by jurisdiction; follow your organisation's policies and involve HR or legal counsel on ratings, pay, conduct and employment decisions.
